column1: # How the course voice says each word written with گ (g) or چ (ch), letters Azure's Iraqi voice skips.
# word as written, without vowel marks <TAB> its sound in IPA (Baghdad). make.mjs copies the ones the course
# uses into words.json voice "ipa"; build_course.py has the voice say those words from their IPA. Written with a
# plain g: Azure's Bassel says that as g (the IPA letter ɡ came out silent in the voice test). A g at the end of a
# word, or before another consonant, is written double (gg) and a word starting with a vowel gets ʔ: said once, the
# voice dropped them (checked with a phoneme recogniser, tools/course/ar-irq/README.md).
